title: Mixed Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Brillante! Has dominado los Mixed Conditionals. Entender cómo acciones pasadas afectan nuestro presente, y viceversa, te da un nivel superior para negociar y analizar situaciones corporativas.

parts.visual:
Los condicionales mixtos combinan el Segundo y el Tercer Condicional. 
Tipo 1: Condición PASADA, Resultado PRESENTE. 
(Si algo hubiera sido diferente en el pasado, el presente sería diferente). 
Estructura: If + Past Perfect, + would + infinitivo. 
Ej: If I HAD BOUGHT bitcoin in 2010 (pasado), I WOULD BE rich now (presente).
parts.audio: Mixed conditionals combine the second and third conditional. Type one is a past condition with a present result. It means if something had been different in the past, the present would be different. The structure is 'If' plus Past Perfect, then 'would' plus infinitive. For example: If I had bought bitcoin in 2010, I would be rich now.

parts.visual:
Tipo 2: Condición PRESENTE (permanente), Resultado PASADO. 
(Si la situación general actual fuera diferente, el pasado habría cambiado). 
Estructura: If + Past Simple, + would have + participio. 
Ej: If I SPOKE Japanese (presente continuo/habilidad), I WOULD HAVE GOTTEN the job in Tokyo last year (resultado pasado).
parts.audio: Type two is a present or permanent condition with a past result. It means if a general, ongoing situation were different, a past event would have changed. The structure is 'If' plus Past Simple, then 'would have' plus past participle. For example: If I spoke Japanese, I would have gotten the job in Tokyo last year.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del condicional mixto.

questions.question: If we had hired him last year, he ____ our CEO right now. (Sería).
If I ____ more careful yesterday, I wouldn't be in the hospital today. (Hubiera sido).
If she wasn't so stubborn, she ____ accepted the deal yesterday. (Habría aceptado).
questions.explanation: Condición permanente/presente (wasn't) -> Resultado pasado (would have accepted).

questions.question: If they ____ (invest) in that startup, they would be billionaires today. (Hubieran invertido).
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (had invested) -> Resultado presente (would be).

questions.question: If I spoke French, I ____ translated the document for you yesterday. (Habría traducido).
questions.explanation: Condición presente (spoke French) -> Resultado pasado (would have translated).

questions.question: If he ____ not lost the keys last night, we wouldn't be locked out now. (No hubiera perdido).
I would have fired him months ago if he ____ my brother! (No fuera).
questions.explanation: Resultado pasado (would have fired) -> Condición permanente (if he weren't my brother). (También se acepta wasn't).

questions.question: If we had left the office on time, we ____ stuck in this traffic jam right now. (No estaríamos).
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (had left) -> Presente (wouldn't be stuck right now).

questions.question: If the company was doing well, they ____ fired 50 people last week. (No habrían despedido).
questions.explanation: Condición presente/permanente (was doing well) -> Resultado pasado (wouldn't have fired).

questions.question: If you ____ (listen) to my advice yesterday, you wouldn't be in this mess today. (Hubieras escuchado).
We ____ a meeting right now if the server hadn't crashed. (Tendríamos / Estaríamos teniendo).
questions.explanation: Resultado presente (would be having) -> Condición pasada (hadn't crashed).

questions.question: If I didn't have so much work today, I ____ to the party last night. (Habría ido).
questions.explanation: Condición actual (didn't have work) -> Resultado pasado (would have gone).

questions.question: If the software ____ better, we wouldn't have lost so many clients last month. (Fuera).
questions.explanation: Condición permanente del software (were) -> Resultado pasado (wouldn't have lost).

questions.question: If they had signed the contract, they ____ our official partners today. (Serían).
If I was a millionaire, I ____ bought that yacht yesterday. (Habría comprado).
questions.explanation: Condición permanente (If I was) -> Resultado pasado (would have bought).

questions.question: If you had studied architecture, you ____ building houses right now. (Estarías).
questions.explanation: Pasado (had studied) -> Presente continuo (would be building).

questions.question: If I didn't love this company, I ____ quit a long time ago. (Habría renunciado).
questions.explanation: Estado permanente (didn't love) -> Acción pasada (would have quit).

questions.question: If we ____ missed the flight, we would be in New York now. (No hubiéramos perdido).
I ____ have called him yesterday if I didn't think it was important. (No habría).
questions.explanation: Resultado pasado (wouldn't have called) -> Condición de estado mental actual/permanente (didn't think).

questions.question: If they ____ stolen the money, they wouldn't be in jail right now. (No hubieran robado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el auxiliar y el verbo (Ej: 'had bought', 'would be', 'would have gone').

questions.question: If I had bought Bitcoin, I ____ (be) rich now. (Sería)
If I ____ (invest) yesterday, I would be happy today. (Hubiera invertido)
If I spoke French, I ____ (translate) it yesterday. (Habría traducido)
If he ____ (not/be) so arrogant, they would have hired him. (No fuera - condición permanente con W)
We ____ (not/be) stuck in traffic now if we had left earlier. (No estaríamos)
If she had won the lottery, she ____ (not/work) here now. (No estaría trabajando - simple)
If I didn't have debt, I ____ (buy) that house last year. (Habría comprado)
If they ____ (sign) it yesterday, we would be partners now. (Hubieran firmado)
If I was faster, I ____ (win) the race yesterday. (Habría ganado)
If he ____ (not/lose) the keys, we wouldn't be outside. (No hubiera perdido)
